description: Mermaid.js org chart templates for different visualization styles

default.name: Default org chart
default.style: Basic boxes with solid reporting lines, dotted cross-functional lines

hierarchical.name: Strict hierarchy
hierarchical.style: Top-down pyramid, strict chain of command, no cross-functional lines

functional.name: Functional grouping
functional.style: Left-to-right. Departments as columns. Highlights cross-functional collaboration.

squad.name: Squad/pod structure
squad.style: Pods as subgraphs. Shows cross-functional teams rather than departments.

matrix.name: Matrix reporting
matrix.style: Dual reporting lines (solid = solid, dotted = dotted). Shows matrix structure.

board.name: Board view
board.style: C-suite only. Clean executive overview with board of directors.
